definitions.explanation: A tall tower built so that visitors can enjoy a wide view of the surrounding scenery.

examples.japanese: {展望塔|てんぼうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
{展望塔|てんぼうとう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一望|いちぼう}→一望：19625_ichibou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the whole town from the observation tower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{展望塔|てんぼうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{遠|とお}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When we climbed the observation tower in the park, we could see the sea in the distance.

notes:
A tower built for taking in scenery. Built from ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧ (a view; outlook) and ⟦{塔|とう}→塔：09944_tou⟧ (tower).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展望塔|てんぼうとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb an observation tower
- {展望塔|てんぼうとう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: the view from the observation tower

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧: observation deck; viewing platform — a platform rather than a freestanding tower
- ⟦{灯台|とうだい}→灯台：04560_toudai⟧: lighthouse — built to guide ships, not for sightseeing
